topic: Data ingestion and status tracking improvements
summary_markdown:
The discussion covered several technical topics, including data access permissions and system monitoring.

**Data Access:** A request was made to grant delete access for models in the `allunite-models` bucket. It was decided that granting full delete access might be too broad; instead, status tracking improvements were discussed.

**System Monitoring/Ingestion:** The team planned to improve system monitoring by implementing a mechanism to alert when uploaded files are unusually small (less than a few hundred bytes). This check will be integrated into existing upload scripts (`jobs/data_upload/upload_day_afa.sh` and `upload_day_walldecaux.sh`).

**Box Status Tracking:** To replace periodic pings, it was decided to implement a status tracking system for boxes (e.g., RZK TP-Link units). The box status (online/offline) will be written directly into PostgreSQL using two fields: `is_offline` and `offline_since`. This approach is preferred over relying solely on ping history in ClickHouse.
decisions: Implement a file size check (< few hundred bytes) for data uploads, integrated into specific upload scripts.
Box status tracking will be implemented by writing 'is_offline' and 'offline_since' fields directly to PostgreSQL.
action_items: The user needs to follow up with the person responsible for data re-uploading (Жека) regarding the completion of remaining days' data uploads.
The file size check fix was pushed and will be deployed/re-uploaded.
